item.title: SHEMM Coach
item.description: Today, let's talk Eating. Your day is stacked end to end, meals wedged between errands, pickups, and chores, which is exactly when eating turns into whatever's fastest instead of what actually fuels you. Skipping or rushing meals under a packed schedule just borrows energy you'll need later. Before the day gets away from you, decide now what and when you're eating, don't leave it to whenever there's a gap. Action: pick your next meal time right now, and stick to it.
